usedFor: Asana is where work gets assigned and Slack is where the team sees it. A “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana can post a “Send Message” in Slack, so the channel hears about each task as it appears.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new task often needs somebody to take it. “Send Interactive Message” carries buttons or a form, so people can answer in Slack instead of opening Asana.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Selected Project” is polling, firing once per task found since the last check, oldest first, so a burst arrives together. A Slack channel post waits for your approval in 50agents.
